lines.en: My wings scrape the cave walls as I go.
Cave paths bend and bend.
I creep along the rock face.
My wingbeat circles the whole cavern.

lines.zh: 地上全是碎石，走起来吵。
lines.en: Gravel everywhere makes me loud.
I head where there's light.
A few more follow behind me.
The cave is close. I'm used to it.
I climb one step at a time.
The crack is deep; I fit inside.
I feel my way out of the dark.
I'm large, so my wings are louder.

lines.zh: 岩缝里的路，我用翅膀量。
lines.en: I measure the cracks with my wings.
Dripping water shows me the way.
I stop and listen.
The ceiling drops. I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我带着一整群在洞里走。
lines.en: I lead a whole swarm through the cave.
Layers of rock press overhead.
I hang from the ceiling to rest.
Slow wingbeats. No hurry.
The echo in here lasts a while.
I stare at that sliver of light at the cave mouth.
The smells here are mixed.
I curl into a lump.
I see better in the dark.
I cling to the stone like this.
Mine is the only sound in here.
A layer of dust settles on my wings.
I count the drips overhead.
A stone shifted. I adjust.
I wait for something to pass.
Wind comes in from the cave mouth.
I fold my legs in.
It's safe here. For now.
You brought light in. I squint first.

lines.zh: 我看你，是在看你带了几个人。
lines.en: I look at you to count who came.

lines.zh: 你站的地方离洞口不远。
lines.en: You're standing not far from the mouth.

lines.zh: 你手里那根火把，烧得很快。
lines.en: That torch of yours burns fast.
I watch you from low on the ground.

lines.zh: 你低头找路，正好看见我。
lines.en: You look down for the path and see me.
The whole swarm is watching you.
Living things rarely come down here.

lines.zh: 你靴子上的泥是从上面带的。
lines.en: The mud on your boots came from above.

lines.zh: 我看不见你的脸，只有光。
lines.en: I can't see your face, only the light.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我的翅膀就响。
lines.en: One step back and my wings sound.

lines.zh: 你手别伸进来，这里太窄。
lines.en: Don't reach in. It's narrow here.
A crack in the shell.
Grit settles on my shell; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 洞里的回声把我喊声放大了。
lines.en: The echo magnifies my cry.
That hit my wing.
What I bleed is grey.
I can still crawl. Just slower.
You thinned my shell.
My kin are crashing about the cave.
It hurts so much my wingbeat breaks.
I press to the stone and go still.
What's in your hand? Can I eat it?

lines.zh: 洞穴里很少有这种味道。
lines.en: We rarely smell that down here.
I won't come closer. Put it down.
The smell alone makes my wings beat.
This one's warm. I like it.
I open my mouth, then hesitate.
Step back first, then I'll go.
Will this fill a belly?
Down here you get hungry fast.
If I bite it, don't blame me.
You're luring me out.
It smells too fresh to be real.
Leave me some.
My wings are fully spread.
I don't trust you, but I want it.
Did that thing move?

lines.zh: 撞到我，会听到很大的振翅声。
lines.en: Bump me and you'll hear loud wings.
There's a thin shell on me.
The tunnel's too narrow for both.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，灰全扬起来了。
lines.en: You bumped and the dust rose.
I back off and my wing sweeps you.
Don't push. Now we're both stuck.
Touching me leaves something sticky.
No room to spread wings in here.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，听得见我的心跳。
lines.en: So close you can hear my heartbeat.
Let me squeeze past.
I'm wider than you are.
The wall blocks my retreat.
In this cave it's cramped.
We press against the cave wall.
One wing has to fold.
The cave is all echo.

lines.zh: 我们这一群都是这样来的。
lines.en: This is how our swarm came about.
Don't just stand there watching.
Two big bodies squeeze together.
In a while there'll be a few more.
A thin shell will be left on the ground.
They're much smaller than us.
I pick up a piece of rubble.
It lay under a layer of dust.

lines.zh: 石缝里卡着东西，我抠出来。
lines.en: Something's wedged in the crack; I pry it out.
What I find down here is mine.
I hide it in a crack.
This one is rather heavy.
I pick it up, then drop it.
There's a layer of ore dust below.
I carry things clumsily.
Leave it. I saw it first.
Someone has entered the cave.
I hear steps on stone.
The whole swarm turns toward you.

lines.zh: 振翅声变大了，听得出吗？
lines.en: The wingbeat's louder. Can you tell?
Your torch is far too visible.
I'm slow, but tunnels are short.

lines.zh: 你先靠近的，不算我主动。
lines.en: You approached first. Not my doing.

lines.zh: 我知道前面有个死胡同。
lines.en: I know there's a dead end ahead.
We've blocked the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 你踩响的石子，替我指了路。
lines.en: The gravel you kicked told me the way.
I follow your torch.

lines.zh: 洞里回声把方向都告诉我了。
lines.en: The echo tells me the direction.
I'm slow, but I keep crawling.

lines.zh: 你绕到哪边，我都能听见。
lines.en: Whichever way you turn, I hear it.

lines.zh: 这一群已经围成半圈了。
lines.en: The swarm has formed a half circle.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到洞壁，无路可退。
lines.en: I've backed you to the cave wall; no way out.

lines.zh: 我翅膀扫过石壁，一直响。
lines.en: My wing scrapes the wall, always.

lines.zh: 洞里没有比这更窄的地方。
lines.en: Nowhere in this cave is narrower.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，从上面下来。
lines.en: I changed angle and come from above.

lines.zh: 你扔的火把灭不了我的方向。
lines.en: Your thrown torch doesn't blind me.

lines.zh: 翅膀一扇，灰全扑你脸上。
lines.en: One wingbeat and dust fills your face.
I bite into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 爪子扣在石头上也扣你。
lines.en: These claws grip stone and you.
The whole swarm goes at once.
I ram you and stagger myself.

lines.zh: 洞里没有地方躲这一下。
lines.en: No room in this cave to dodge that.

lines.zh: 翅膀一合，我整个撞上去。
lines.en: My wings snap shut as I ram my whole bulk in.
The wing swept you into the wall.
That bite caught no flesh.
Rocks fall with the blow.
I crawl out of the deep cave.
The rock here just shifted.
I brought a whole swarm.
The wingbeat arrives first; I follow.
The air in the cave changed.

lines.zh: 石壁裂开，我先探出翅膀。
lines.en: The wall splits; my wings come out first.
I know this level of the cave.
I land and the dust rises.
We only appear in caves.
I've closed the way behind me.

lines.zh: 火光照进洞里，我的壳在烧。
lines.en: Firelight in the cave; my shell burns.
Dropped from the ceiling; the shell broke.
Water poured in and I couldn't float up.

lines.zh: 洞被炸塌，石头全压下来。
lines.en: The cave collapsed and rock fell on me.

lines.zh: 箭扎进翅膀，我飞不起来。
lines.en: An arrow in my wing; I can't fly.
That light is too sharp in this cave.
Hungry long enough, the shell thins.
Lightning ran down the rock face.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有石壁可以抓。
lines.en: In the void there's no stone to grip.
